kind: human-read observation of a Cloudflare-protected page
reader: session agent, normal desktop browser context through a documentation proxy (not the GitHub runner)
policy: Observation only. No value here becomes a probability or a pick. The project's aggregated-reference rung accepts only a published bookmaker-average sentence that can be retained and hash-checked; listing-page numbers are not that sentence.
why_recorded: The published 'no betting line' limitation for model-only fixtures says no external price was reachable. A reader can load EGamersWorld, so this record documents exactly what that site showed for those fixtures, including where its own two surfaces disagree.

limitation: These are date-stamped reads of a page that refuses the automated runner (HTTP 403 to requests and to headless Chromium, recorded in line-sources.json).
